digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, workflow interpreter, verdict dispatch
propositions: A malformed criteria configuration during assemble-step execution causes CriteriaError, but the generic workflow recorder loses typed exception identity and preserves only an undifferentiated string.
Plan-review gate dispatch incorrectly routes every unrecognized failed workflow through the generic LLM-degradation tail, which unconditionally sets llm_unavailable=true regardless of root cause.
The current verdict incorrectly labels a local config-parse failure as an LLM outage, misleading operators toward provider credentials instead of installed-build/repository mismatches.

The repair must catch CriteriaError at the criteria-assembly boundary, preserve failure identity as a structured marker, and route only that specific marker to a dedicated config-fault verdict path before generic LLM degradation.

The config-fault verdict must emit INDETERMINATE with full deterministic coverage, omit affirmative llm_unavailable, and provide actionable diagnostic naming the running installed rebar build as suspect.
Genuine LLMUnavailableError and healthy provider paths must remain byte-for-byte unchanged; deterministic blockers must not be masked by config-fault INDETERMINATE.
